ye2023_data_json.title: Ye et al. (2023)
ye2023_data_json.subtitle: Discovery of the shell structure via break radii in the outer halo of the Milky Way
ye2023_data_json.summary: This study uses Gaia DR3 RR Lyrae stars to map the stellar halo density profile, identifying shell structures via density break radii. This model version represents their classical BPL fit in the 6 - 26 kpc bin (coinciding with the first GSE apocentre break) and includes a 1 kpc constant density core.
